editor.premise: Prepare for a new school term through make-ahead breakfasts, home resets, and practical study-space organization.

chapters.name: Introduction
chapters.purpose: Explain the practical preparation advice connecting the coming activities.

chapters.name: Breakfast preparation
chapters.purpose: Turn a morning-saving suggestion into a demonstrated recipe and finished batch.

chapters.name: Home reset
chapters.purpose: Establish the clutter, then compress unpacking and tidying into visible progress.

chapters.name: Bathroom organization
chapters.purpose: Solve counter clutter with storage, then inspect the organized result.

chapters.name: Desk organization
chapters.purpose: Introduce the workspace problem and begin a detailed cable-sorting process.

captions.note: Small bottom-centred speech captions dominate; larger central headings introduce activities. Ingredient graphics and occasional arrows add instructions without interrupting the footage.

editor.notes: Keep explanations readable, then accelerate repetitive handwork with fixed-angle jumps. Hold finished results and useful demonstrations longer. Establish clutter before sorting; use brief dissolves for elapsed cooking time, not every transition.
